limitations: The original recipe was paused during observations when the main GUI exposed the whole-image DSP admission gap. Completed clean captures were retained, interrupted captures were rerun from fresh saves, two regression routes were added, and the corrected generator and qualifier were copied before any clean native translation. Source deltas are recorded explicitly.

The final clean sound corpus contains all eighteen observer routes; the main product corpus contains sixteen authorizing routes with two held-out regressions. Both independently generate identical DSP source and the same 16,746 slot instruction variants.
This establishes behavioral reproduction and generated processor-source agreement, not byte-identical linked binaries. Absolute build paths affect some generated include paths and binary identities.
The clean packaged-host checks are headless. Main-app live presentation, audio-device behavior and UI observations are separate.
Bounded replay and processor checks do not establish exhaustive gameplay, every possible session input sequence, physical controller operation or physical arcade-board accuracy.

originalObservations.scope: Every observation was produced in this clean workspace by its freshly built original processor observer. No main-workspace observations were imported.
